description: Create the rewards viewers redeem with channel points, and choose what the bot says when they do.
degraded: Channel points are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
reconnect: Reconnect your Twitch account to manage channel points. One extra permission is needed.
botOnHint: Master switch: the bot only reacts to redemptions while this is on.
inspectorIdle: Select a reward to edit it here, or create a new one.
emptySub: Create your first reward and it appears in your Twitch channel’s points menu right away.
errTitleRequired: Enter a name for this reward.
fieldPromptPh: Shown under the reward on Twitch
requireInput: Ask the viewer to type a message with the redeem
queueHint: What happens to each redeem in your Twitch requests queue.
limitPerStreamHint: Set to 1 to make it claimable once per stream.
fieldCounterHint: Each redemption adds 1 to this counter (create it on the Counters page).
fieldCounterScopeHint: Only used when creating the counter here. Reward title separates each reward’s per-user tally.
fieldPointsHint: Points the redeemer earns per redemption. 0 awards nothing.
deleteBody: “{name}” is removed from Twitch and the bot stops reacting to it. This cannot be undone.
discardBody: You have unsaved changes to this reward. Discard them?
toastDuplicateTitle: A reward with this title already exists on your channel. Pick another title.
errCost: Enter a whole number of points, at least 1.
errLimit: Enter a whole number, at least 1.
errCooldown: Enter a cooldown between 1 second and 7 days.
